stories.title: Fever avoid addressing pro-Cunningham rally
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham and Caitlin Clark were not made available to answer postgame questions about a rally before the Fever's 105-95 win over the Storm on Tuesday night in support of Cunningham's recent comments about transgender athletes.

stories.title: Shanahan: Crash was my fault, report was wrong
stories.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan wanted to make clear he was at fault for the car crash that left him with serious injuries two weeks ago.

stories.title: Bieber, former Cy Young winner, walks six in 1st
stories.summary: Toronto Blue Jays pitcher Shane Bieber, a former Cy Young Award winner, issued walks to six of the nine batters he faced Tuesday, including three with the bases full, before exiting after two-thirds of an inning in an 8-6 loss to the Washington Nationals.

stories.title: Ole Miss sues 2 players, now at LSU, over buyouts
stories.summary: Ole Miss is seeking close to $1 million in penalties from former players Princewill Umanmielen and Devin Harper, who signed revenue sharing contracts to return to the Rebels this season before joining former coach Lane Kiffin at LSU.

stories.title: Giants' Bader further injures foot in scooter crash
stories.summary: Giants center fielder Harrison Bader is awaiting evaluation after a scooter crash caused further damage to an already injured left foot.
